steps.title: Initialize Android Project Structure
steps.description: Set up the basic directory and file structure for the Android application.

steps.title: Define Backend API Schema
steps.description: Describe the data collections, fields, and operations for interacting with the backend API, including the notes collection with title, content, and category fields.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Files
steps.description: Set up the project-level and app-level build.gradle files with required SDK versions and dependencies.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Declare application components, permissions, and set the application theme.

steps.title: Implement Backend API Client
steps.description: Develop a Java class (BackendApi.java) for handling network requests to the TrumpleDroid backend for user authentication and CRUD operations on notes.

steps.title: Create Note Data Model
steps.description: Define a Java class to represent a 'Note' object, including its ID, title, content, and category.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Create the XML layout for the MainActivity, including a ListView to display notes and an EditText for search functionality.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity (Note List & Search)
steps.description: Develop the MainActivity Java code to fetch all notes, display them in a list, and implement local search/filter functionality.

steps.title: Create Note List Item Layout and Adapter
steps.description: Design the layout for individual note items in the list and implement a custom ArrayAdapter to populate the ListView.

steps.title: Design Note Edit Activity Layout
steps.description: Create the XML layout for the NoteEditActivity, including EditText fields for title, content, and category, and buttons for saving and deleting notes.

steps.title: Implement Note Edit Activity (Create/Update/Delete)
steps.description: Develop the NoteEditActivity Java code to handle creating new notes, editing existing notes, and deleting notes using the BackendApi.

steps.title: Add Menu for New Note Creation and Search
steps.description: Implement an options menu in MainActivity to allow users to add new notes and activate the search functionality.

steps.title: Integrate API Calls for CRUD Operations
steps.description: Ensure all activities correctly use the BackendApi for creating, reading, updating, and deleting note records.

steps.title: Implement User Interface for Authentication (Login/Register)
steps.description: Develop activities and layouts for user registration and login to secure access to notes.

steps.title: Add Shared Preferences for Token Management
steps.description: Implement secure storage and retrieval of authentication tokens using Android's SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Implement Logout Functionality
steps.description: Add a menu option or button for users to log out of the application.

steps.title: Final Review and Testing
steps.description: Perform a comprehensive review of the code and test all features including CRUD, categories, search, authentication, and error handling.

steps.title: Building Notes App
steps.description: Compile and package the application for deployment.
